sentences.scenario: Say how much you studied last class.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我们一点学习 by placing the amount after the verb.
Direct correction of the unnecessary 是 before 干净.

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bǐ wǒ zhīdào de duō.
sentences.english_hint: They know more than I do.
sentences.scenario: Compare your knowledge with experienced teammates.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the learner's word order when describing experienced colleagues.

sentences.chinese: 我们的例会都是视频会议。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de lìhuì dōu shì shìpín huìyì.
sentences.english_hint: Our regular meetings are all video meetings.
sentences.scenario: Explain how your team holds regular meetings.
sentences.source_note: Analysis correction distinguishes regular meetings from their video format; learner works from home.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yì yǒu xiāoxi, jiù tōngzhī nǐ.
sentences.english_hint: I'll notify you as soon as I have an update.
sentences.scenario: Promise a colleague a quick update.
sentences.source_note: Core analysis model; 消息 and 通知 caused repeated hesitation during the lesson.

sentences.chinese: 中文课一结束，我就去工作。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngwén kè yì jiéshù, wǒ jiù qù gōngzuò.
sentences.english_hint: I'll go to work as soon as Chinese class ends.
sentences.scenario: Describe your plan immediately after class.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill answer addresses difficulty producing a complete 一……就…… sentence.

sentences.chinese: 如果系统有问题，我们就检查一下。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ xìtǒng yǒu wèntí, wǒmen jiù jiǎnchá yíxià.
sentences.english_hint: If the system has a problem, we'll check it.
sentences.scenario: Explain your team's response to a system problem.
sentences.source_note: Analysis model grounded in the learner's description of system problems at work.

sentences.chinese: 如果他们需要帮忙，就给我们打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tāmen xūyào bāngmáng, jiù gěi wǒmen dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.english_hint: If they need help, they call us.
sentences.scenario: Explain how another team asks your team for help.
sentences.source_note: Analysis model reinforces 需要帮忙, a chunk the learner struggled to produce at work.

sentences.chinese: 如果客户不满意，我们就商量一下。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ kèhù bù mǎnyì, wǒmen jiù shāngliang yíxià.
sentences.english_hint: If the customer is unhappy, we'll discuss it.
sentences.scenario: Suggest what to do about an unhappy customer.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill answer combines the customer context with the repeatedly practiced 商量一下.

sentences.pinyin: Xià kè yǐhòu, wǒ qù kàn nǚ'ér.
sentences.english_hint: After class, I'll go see my daughter.
sentences.scenario: Say when you will go see your daughter.
sentences.source_note: Analysis model practices time order using the learner's established family context.

sentences.chinese: 我们开会是为了解决问题。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen kāi huì shì wèile jiějué wèntí.
sentences.english_hint: We hold meetings to solve problems.
sentences.scenario: Explain why your team is meeting.
sentences.source_note: Core purpose model in the analysis and its recommended practice routine.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yì bǎi tái diànnǎo.
sentences.scenario: Identify a group of one hundred computers in a work example.
sentences.source_note: Adds a complete sentence around 一百台电脑; the learner repeatedly omitted 台.

sentences.pinyin: Jiàgé diē le yì bǎi měiyuán.
sentences.english_hint: The price fell by one hundred dollars.
sentences.scenario: Describe a price decrease in a product example.
sentences.source_note: Direct analysis correction of 一百美元跌了; price-change wording recurred.

sentences.chinese: 我可以给你百分之十五的折扣。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ gěi nǐ bǎifēnzhī shíwǔ de zhékòu.
sentences.english_hint: I can give you a fifteen percent discount.
sentences.scenario: Offer the product discount discussed in class.
sentences.source_note: Uses the analysis's corrected 百分之十五的折扣; reversed percentage order recurred.
